sampling_policy: cyclic corpus quotas within each phone; unique eligible speakers; capacity-constrained redistribution; same positive pairs, phone sequence and total valid slots as original
comparison_policy: primary paired control is original expanded280 of the same seed; report original baseline140 and expanded210 as context
outcome_policy: report all conditions and seeds; assess CV FRR reduction and JTube EER tradeoff together; no best-seed selection or test-based threshold adjustment
interpretation: exploratory sampling intervention on previously observed test sets; no claim of new-domain generalization
